name: Architecture Decision Record
description: An ADR: context, the decision, alternatives considered, and consequences.
prompt_template:
You are writing a architecture decision record for the service described by this spec.

{grounding_context}

Use ONLY the assertions above. Every claim must trace to one. If a required fact is absent, write '[not specified in spec]' rather than inventing it. Reproduce any assertion marked Tier 1 verbatim.

Produce these sections: context, decision, alternatives_considered, consequences, status.
